# Store append loads drop or replace rows and reset the grid

## Context

The Store portion of #17835 is independently reproducible after the scroll-edge protocol and its Institution consumers shipped. The originating author agreed to extract this bounded repair and retire the superseded protocol prescription.

At `dev@42b80fee8102664f9e9fc1d19373efabf0aa00f9`, a real-Store five-arm probe confirms:
- populated Pipeline + bulk response + `append:true`: the new page is swallowed;
- populated API Store + `append:true`: the old rows are replaced;
- ordinary Pipeline replacement still works;
- the built-in Stream parser appends nonempty chunks exactly once and leaves an empty stream unchanged.

## The Problem

`Store.load` honors append when deciding whether to clear for a Pipeline, then admits its bulk result only when `count === 0`. The API branch always assigns `data`, whose setter clears the old collection. Merely fixing membership is insufficient: an appended page reported as an ordinary load makes a bound grid reset to the top.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/data/Store.mjs:954–1077` owns transport result admission; its blob is `a025804e40b3cb5ae3ee2bacb4ff835abbf60ec0`.
- `Store.add` owns Model conversion and normal collection notifications; `afterSetData:338–351` is the replacement path.
- `onCollectionMutate:1116–1127` carries the existing `postChunkLoad` continuation signal. `grid.Body.onStoreLoad` suppresses the scroll-to-top dispatch when that signal is true. `list.Buffered.onStoreLoad` already preserves its scroll anchor.
- The built-in `parser.Stream` emits nonempty data chunks and returns count metadata, not a second aggregate. Other parsers can emit data events; avoid adding a returned aggregate twice.
- `currentPage` is an explicit caller input here. A caller selects `params.page`; this repair does not advance the config or add an acquisition fence.

## The Fix

Repair the successful append paths in `Store.load`, using the existing `add` and continuation-notification contract. A non-progressive Pipeline result is admitted on a populated Store; the API path adds instead of replacing when requested. Appended records retain normal conversion, filtering and sorting. All load notifications caused by that append must describe continuation, including the final Pipeline notification.

Preserve ordinary replacement and existing progressive rendering. Keep any notification context local to the data commit, not across the asynchronous request. Extend the existing Store loading tests and the owning grid load/scroll tests; no new production module.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback / edge | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Store.load({append:true})`, bulk Pipeline | Existing append option and `Store.add` | Keep old rows and admit the fetched page once | Empty result retains rows; streamed chunks are not added again from a final aggregate | `load` JSDoc | Populated, empty and stream controls |
| API append | Existing `api.read` branch and collection membership | Add successful response rows; resolve to the held collection, consistent with Pipeline append | Unsuccessful response keeps rows and current null/refusal behavior | `load` JSDoc | Real Store with a controlled API service |
| Load continuation | Existing `postChunkLoad` / `grid.Body.onStoreLoad` | An append is incremental and does not request a scroll-to-top | Non-append and unrelated later mutations/sorts retain existing semantics | Event/loader JSDoc | Load-envelope assertions and a bound-grid reset control |
| Paging input | Existing `params.page` / `currentPage` | Caller owns the page requested; no implicit advancement | Rejection does not advance page metadata; no new streamed rollback promise | `load` JSDoc | Explicit-page and failed-read controls |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A populated Store retains old rows and admits the new page for both a bulk Pipeline and a successful API append; returned data agrees with the held collection.
- [ ] Built-in streaming, empty responses, and a data-event/final-response combination add each page once; ordinary non-append replacement remains unchanged.
- [ ] A mounted grid receiving the append does not request a scroll-to-top; replacement still does. No append marker leaks into an unrelated later mutation/sort.
- [ ] Failed reads retain the existing failure behavior and do not implicitly advance `currentPage`; the caller-owned page contract is documented.
- [ ] Focused Store/grid tests and the relevant data/grid regression suites pass under their named configs.

## Out of Scope

`edgeDemand`, view-owned acquisition fences, retries, automatic page-number advancement, transactional rollback of already-rendered stream chunks, Institution pane changes and Buffered-list feature expansion.

## Avoided Traps

Do not remove the bulk guard in a way that re-adds progressive data. Do not use `isLoading` as a new single-flight guarantee or manufacture streaming state to suppress scrolling. Do not repair a Store result-admission defect in each consumer.
